subject: BlueHarbor follow-up: confirmation of model-learning opt-out and log retention plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Navarro <alex@blueharbor.ai>, Jordan Pierce <jordant@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: BlueHarbor discovery recap + ask: written confirmation for no-model-learning

Hi Alex / Jordan —

Thanks again for the product demo this morning. Quick recap and the asks we agreed to confirm in writing: 

- Data in scope: API payloads, uploaded documents (PDF/CSV), and end-user messages routed through Redwood.
- PII sensitivity: you marked SSNs and full DOBs as "restricted"; we should enforce masking at ingestion.
- Residency: US (us-east) preferred for logging and any persistent artifacts.
- Retention / logs: discussed short-term audit logs for debugging; please confirm the retention window you need.
- Opt-out: you requested that BlueHarbor customer data NOT be used by Redwood to improve or fine-tune models (no model learning).

Next steps I promised: please reply to this thread with a short written confirmation of the Opt-Out (scoped to BlueHarbor production data), your preferred log retention window, and the procurement contact so we can put the opt-out into the SOW/addendum. We attached our standard security questionnaire in case you want to run through controls offline.

Attachments: security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (short answers sheet)

If you confirm, Marissa (security) will draft the opt-out addendum and Ben (procurement lead) will loop procurement to generate the PO/SOW path.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

From: Alex Navarro <alex@blueharbor.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Pierce <jordant@blueharbor.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 19:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor discovery recap + ask: written confirmation for no-model-learning

Soojin — thanks for the clear notes. Confirming the key points from our side: 

- BlueHarbor requests an explicit "no model learning" commitment: Redwood must not use any BlueHarbor production data to train or improve public or private weights (including offline fine-tuning and continual learning) without a separate written agreement.
- Residency: US (us-east) for any persisted logs or backups.
- Retention: we prefer a 45-day retention for debug/audit logs; beyond that logs should be purged unless a showstopper incident requires extended retention (we will request an extension via security@blueharbor.ai).
- PII redaction: we will need token-level redaction for SSNs and full DOBs before logs are stored; we are open to API-side masking or a joint sanitization pipeline.

Attaching our internal data policy for reference: blueharbor_data_policy_v3.pdf.

Please have your security/ops team confirm the exact mechanism for the redaction and the operational assurance (audit trail) for the 45-day retention. Once we have that, procurement (procurement@blueharbor.ai) will sign the addendum.

Thanks,
Alex Navarro
Head of Platform Engineering | BlueHarbor Analytics
alex@blueharbor.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor discovery recap + ask: written confirmation for no-model-learning

Alex — really appreciate the quick confirmation. Short technical + contractual summary from Redwood's side and proposed next steps: 

Technical commitments (we will implement these for BlueHarbor when the addendum is signed):
- Data usage: mark all BlueHarbor tenant traffic with a no_train flag at ingestion. This prevents any telemetry or customer content from being included in model updates, telemetry corpuses, or offline tuning pipelines.
- KV/cache: KV cache will be disabled for requests that include the opt-out flag; ephemeral caches for performance will be bounded and never persisted beyond request lifetime.
- Redaction: Redwood can apply an API-side token masking transform to remove SSNs and full DOBs prior to log storage. We will provide the transform spec and sample sanitizer within 3 business days.
- Retention & residency: audit/debug logs will be stored in us-east and purged after 45 days by default. We will surface an immutable audit trail (who accessed what) for the 45-day window.

Contractual path:
- I attached a short addendum draft that codifies the above: Redwood-OptOut-Addendum-1.0.pdf. Once you confirm, we'll route it for signature (DocuSign link included below). The addendum will be appended to the SOW and to the master services agreement.
- Procurement: Ben, can you confirm the PO/SOW process and whether BlueHarbor requires net-30 or a vendor form?

Action items:
- Alex / procurement@blueharbor.ai: confirm acceptance of the addendum language and provide procurement contact.
- BlueHarbor security: review the sanitizer spec we will send and confirm it meets your redaction requirements.
- Redwood legal/security: finalize DocuSign-ready addendum after confirmation.

Attachments: Redwood-OptOut-Addendum-1.0.pdf, Redwood-DataHandling-SLA-draft.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
